d:
Weird NHL is back. Ottawa's Thomas Chabot and Shane Pinto somehow get their skates tangled together, referee TJ Luxmore offers Jacob Fowler an apple, and the Winnipeg crowd has plenty to say during Connor Hellebuyck's return with the New Jersey Devils.
Plus, sticks are breaking, flying into the crowd and getting wedged in the boards, while Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen, Laurent Brossoit and other goaltenders find themselves dealing with some unusual equipment situations.
Just when you think you've seen it all in hockey, Weird NHL Volume 144 finds something new!
